basic_info.description: Light, bright and spacious - this 2/1 condo located smack dab in the heart of Duboce Triangle - if you know it you love it! Updated kitchen and bath; refinished hardwood floors; private decked outdoor space perfect for entertaining; 1 car independent garage parking and extra storage; easy access to parks, restaurants and public transportation - and oh so much more.
